title: Lagi! Lagi!
subject: a young woman who runs the pirate-ship swing at a travelling funfair on a town padang, pushing it higher every time the kids scream 'lagi', and on the last night gives a free ride to the boy in blue slippers who watched every night without a ticket
caption: Hardstyle dance-pop, a sung pop song on a festival hardstyle beat. A distorted hardstyle kick with a pitched, punchy tail driving every beat; a reverse bass rolling on the off-beats; a wide detuned supersaw lead playing the chorus hook; a bright trance pluck arpeggio under the verses; a filtered breakdown with only the pluck and the voice before the kick returns. Big, loud festival mix, kick and lead forward, supersaws wide, a little fairground crowd noise in the breakdown. Female pop vocal, bright and strong in a mid-high register, singing the verses over the filtered beat and leading a chant-along chorus. 150 BPM, A minor. Euphoric, rowdy and warm-hearted. No trap beat, no dubstep wobble, no idol-pop rap, no autotune, no rap verse, no slow ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - filtered pluck, kick enters]

[Verse 1]
Padang bandar, minggu ni kami singgah
Lampu kelip, jagung bakar, rumput lecak
Aku pegang lever kapal lanun
Tiket lima ringgit, pegang kuat-kuat

[Pre-Chorus]
Ayun sekali, budak menjerit
Ayun dua kali, mak bapak pun sama

[Chorus]
Lagi! Lagi! Tinggi lagi!
Satu padang jerit tak berhenti
Lagi! Lagi! Sampai bintang
Tolak lever, kita naik lagi

[Verse 2]
Ada budak pakai selipar biru
Tiap malam berdiri tepi pagar
Tak ada tiket, dia cuma tengok
Kira berapa kali kapal naik

[Breakdown - filtered pluck and voice only, fairground crowd noise]
Esok kami angkat khemah ke Taiping
Aku panggil dia, "Dik, naik sini"

[Chorus - kick and supersaw lead return, crowd chanting along]
Lagi! Lagi! Tinggi lagi!
Kapal kosong, cuma dia sorang
Lagi! Lagi! Sampai bintang
Selipar biru tercabut sebelah

[Outro - supersaw lead and crowd]
Esok Taiping, lusa Ipoh
Kalau dengar orang jerit, itu kami
